name: Felsworn: Ruin Inner Demon DoT deals 30% of displayed damage against level-scaled creatures (#13334)
contract: Issue #13334: level-33 Felsworn casting Ruin rank 3 (501293) in Inner Demon (804216) inside a
level-scaled dungeon (Blackfathom Deeps, map 48) observed the Inner Demon burn (805748) dealing
only a scaled-down fraction (~15%) of Ruin's displayed damage instead of 30% over 3 sec.
Destiny Weaver converts player damage from viewer-scale into the creature's real health pool
inside Unit::DealDamage via sScriptMgr->DealDamage (DamageDealtToPool = realMaxHealth / viewMaxHealth).
Unit::DealDamage previously returned that real-pool value to Unit::DealSpellDamage -> scriptDamageResult
-> OnSpellHitResult, so AscensionFelswornAbilities.cpp computed CopyDot(805748, damage * 30 / 100)
from the real-pool-scaled amount instead of the displayed hit (double-scaling the follow-up DoT).
Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1. A level-33
Felsworn with world scaling enabled views a level-1 hostile (entry 1501, real health 100000) above
level 24 with view max health well above 100000 (DamageDealtToPool << 0.5). Neutralizes partial
resists (823764 per ADR 0154) and crits (33143). Total 805748 damage over its 3 ticks must match
0.30 +/- 0.02 of Ruin 501293's displayed hit (without the fix, the ratio drops below 0.05).

steps.label: SETUP: enemy is scaled up toward the level-33 Felsworn
SETUP: enemy view max health exceeds real 100000 pool so DamageDealtToPool < 0.5
Activate Inner Demon consuming 6 Felfury (30 s duration)
Clear GCD after activating Inner Demon
Cast Ruin Rank 3 (2.5 s cast + missile) in Inner Demon against the scaled enemy
SETUP: Ruin Rank 3 lands with positive damage
CONTROL: Ruin had zero partial resist
Let all 3 ticks of Inner Demon Ruin DoT (805748, 3000 ms duration) complete
SETUP: Inner Demon Ruin DoT 805748 finished ticking
CONTROL: Inner Demon Ruin DoT had zero partial resist
FIX: Inner Demon Ruin DoT 805748 deals 30% of Ruin's displayed hit on a level-scaled creature
